quotes: Small, steady habits shape your hormones more than any single perfect day.
Light one block today and let tomorrow build on it.
globalTips: Morning sunlight exposure within 30 minutes of waking anchors the master circadian clock in the suprachiasmatic nucleus.
Combining non-heme iron sources (like lentils) with organic acids like ascorbic acid maximizes uptake.

q: when should I get morning light
how does sunlight help my body clock
qa.a: Morning sunlight within about 30 minutes of waking helps anchor your body clock, which is set by the suprachiasmatic nucleus in the brain.

q: how can I absorb more iron from lentils
how do I get more iron from plant foods
qa.a: Eat non-heme iron foods such as lentils together with a vitamin C source such as capsicum or citrus. Ascorbic acid helps your body take up more of the iron.

q: how to reduce a glucose spike after a meal
walk after a carb heavy meal
qa.a: A short walk of about 10 minutes soon after a carbohydrate-heavy meal can reduce the rise in blood glucose.

q: when should I stop drinking coffee
qa.a: Caffeine can delay melatonin and lighten deep sleep. Many people sleep better if they stop about 6 hours before bed.
